description: A module to list Pritunl organizations using the Pritunl API.

parameters.name: organization
parameters.description: Name of the Pritunl organization to search for. If none provided, the module returns all Pritunl organizations.

parameters.name: pritunl_api_secret
parameters.description: API Secret found in Administrators > USERNAME > API Secret.

parameters.name: pritunl_api_token
parameters.description: API Token of a Pritunl admin user. It needs to be enabled in Administrators > USERNAME > Enable Token Authentication.

parameters.name: pritunl_url
parameters.description: URL and port of the Pritunl server on which the API is enabled.

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: If certificates should be validated or not. This should never be set to false, except if you are very sure that your connection to the server can not be subject to a Man In The Middle attack. Choices: false true ← (default)

examples:
- name: List all existing Pritunl organizations
  community.general.pritunl_org_info:

- name: Search for an organization named MyOrg
  community.general.pritunl_user_info:
    organization: MyOrg

return_values.name: organizations
return_values.description: List of Pritunl organizations.
